title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-27
source: Matrix 60% soundboard/40% audience; sources: 1 - SBD>Cass/1>DAT>HD-P2>Soundforge 6.0>Flac Frontend>FLAC  (shnid 78746) Tranfer by Jake Clemens 2 - (FOB) Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B) (shnid 102570) Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Great matrix mix captures a smoking show, highlighted by an impressive nine‑minute Other One.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the soaring energy of this performance, especially the extended, impressive Other One that runs over nine minutes. The matrix recording, mastered by Charlie Miller, delivers a well‑balanced sound with Jerry’s guitar prominent, though the audience can be a bit loud at times. Overall it’s a highly recommended listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4‑5) and enthusiastic comments about both the performance (standout Other One) and the matrix recording indicate a strong show with good technical quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix source praised for capturing the venue’s feel; mastering by Charlie Miller improves balance, Jerry is louder in mix, audience level a bit high but overall well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the show as "smoking" and full of energy, with no specific criticisms about pacing or transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted as louder in the mix and appreciated after mastering; his tone is praised.
